summary.en: UK guitar bands reclaim sixties pop lineage on the nineties charts.
summary.zh: 英国吉他乐队在 90 年代榜单上重申六十年代流行谱系。

body.en: Britpop answers Grunge's US radio dominance with bright melody and British identity. It looks back to Beatles/Kinks lineages and returns nineties UK rock to mainstream press and charts.
body.zh: Britpop 以明快旋律与英国身份回应 Grunge 对美国电台的占据。它回望 Beatles / Kinks 谱系，把 90 年代英国摇滚重新推入主流媒体与榜单。
